business_process: Owner email, files, and records (all four entities)
description: Email for four domains; stored contracts, leases, applications, and tenant and vendor correspondence; the recovery address and administrator account for every other system
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every password reset, vendor security notice, and bank alert goes to the owner's mailbox, so no other function can be recovered without it; Florida breach notices run on a 30-day clock that starts with determination. The 24-hour RPO is not supported today: email and files have no backup beyond the vendor's 30-day deleted-item retention
source_evidence: EV-028 (owner BIA worksheet); EV-003 (owner email is the reset address for every system); EV-002 (30-day retention; no backup)
manual_workaround: Phone calls from the mobile phone; vendor web portals signed in from the phone app where already signed in; paper copies of the four management agreements and insurance policies in the home office
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; mobile carrier (text-message codes)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-manager (single point of failure); home office

business_process: Storage rentals, gate access, and rent collection (Storage)
description: Online and walk-in move-ins; gate codes; monthly autopay and card payments; delinquency notices; move-outs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 150 rented units and about $850 of rent a day; autopay runs on the 1st; tenants locked out of their units complain within hours; the gate controller keeps existing codes working while the cloud system is down, which sets the 48-hour MTD
source_evidence: EV-028 (owner BIA worksheet); EV-024 (occupancy and rent); EV-007 (autopay; gate integration); EV-012 (gate keeps stored codes)
manual_workaround: Paper move-in forms kept at the Storage office; manager escorts new tenants through the gate until codes can be issued; card payments taken later
dependent_systems: SYS-05; SYS-09 (Storage desktop; gate controller; router); SYS-01
dependent_third_parties: Storage management system vendor and its payment processor; gate equipment installer; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Storage facility manager (part-time); owner-manager; Storage office

business_process: Payments, payroll, and bookkeeping (all four entities)
description: Vendor and contractor payments; biweekly payroll for 3 LLC employees; management fee transfers; monthly reconciliations; tax deposits through the payroll service
process_owner: Owner-manager (bookkeeper prepares; owner releases every payment)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll is due every second Friday; a redirected payment can be recovered only if the bank is told within hours; payroll tax deposits are made by the payroll service on its schedule; reconciliations can wait a month
source_evidence: EV-028 (owner BIA worksheet); EV-006 (payroll every second Friday); EV-005 (owner is the only bank user); EV-020 (vendor RTO and RPO)
manual_workaround: Pay staff by bank transfer from the online banking app using the last pay register; hold all new or changed payees until the owner calls the payee at a number already on file
dependent_third_parties: Bank; accounting service vendor; payroll service vendor; outside bookkeeper
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-manager (only person who can release payments); outside bookkeeper

description: Machine payments by card and app; wash-and-fold order intake, pickup, and delivery; attendant schedules
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $660 of revenue a day, about 60% of it by card or app; coin acceptors keep the machines running; regular wash-and-fold customers move to a competitor if orders are missed for more than two days
source_evidence: EV-028 (owner BIA worksheet); EV-025 (daily revenue; card and app share; coin acceptors)
manual_workaround: Coin-only operation with a sign on the door; paper order tickets for wash-and-fold, entered in the POS after recovery
dependent_third_parties: Laundry payment platform vendor; internet provider

description: Listings; applications and tenant screening; leases; rent by ACH through the tenant portal; maintenance requests
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $16,700 of rent a month is due on the 1st and late fees start after a grace period, so a few days of outage costs little; maintenance requests also come by phone; adverse action notices must still go to declined applicants
source_evidence: EV-028 (owner BIA worksheet); EV-008 (rent roll: about $16,700 a month due on the 1st); EV-026 (adverse action notices)
manual_workaround: Tenants pay by check or bank transfer; maintenance requests by phone to the owner; paper applications held until the platform returns
dependent_third_parties: Property management platform vendor and its consumer reporting agency partner; maintenance contractor
